integrity: The all-dimensional theorem is proved in RESULT.md. Finite tests in checker.py are reproducibility corroboration only; no independent external certification or priority guarantee is asserted.
limitations: The input is the complete pair-indexed facet-angle matrix, not the multiset of angles. Edge weights are recovered only up to global scalar. Only connected undirected positively weighted loopless graphs and dimension at least two are considered. Floating-point checks are noncertifying; independent historical priority is not established.
title: Angular recognition and weighted-graph reconstruction for Laplacian-column simplices
